title: Bound one-entrant delayed correction banks
body:
Advance each of 119 already excluded correction cuts on the exact #7334 word to just before the next target operand contact, keeping the pre-ADD source and paid itinerary fixed. Of 13 changed cuts, seven retain an exact separator and two fail fresh exact span tests. Four remain unresolved. No literal one-row donor passed. **NO VERIFIED GAIN.**

From a clean POSIX checkout with CPython 3.12, run `python3.12 -I -B research/p104-one-entrant-delayed-correction-bound/replay.py`. The package pins the exact #7334/#7113 word and caller, the prior receipts, engines and output hashes by path. It exercises both entrant evaluators, independently reconstructs the selected rank-203 augmented-bank exclusion, and rejects a mutated cut. It names the four unresolved keys. Registered replay, official read-only standalone export replay, exact commit checks and 27 onboarding tests passed locally. The next test within this scope would be a 30-second exact quotient span at `[41805,41807,43313]`.

#7434 supplied the historical case inventory and controls. #7436 supplied the earlier exact separators, including the alternate one. #7334 and #7113 supplied the literal word and physical caller. OpenAI Codex and its subagents materially assisted the proof, implementation, independent replay and packaging.
